pages.title: Brewing and Fermenting
pages.text: **Brewin' and Chewin'** adds fermenting. A keg takes ingredients and a liquid, then slowly turns them into a drink or a preserved food. Drinks are served in a tankard and give status effects as well as food value.

pages.title: Keg
pages.text: Holds ingredients and fluid while they ferment over time. Output is a bottle or a food item. Check JEI for each recipe and how long it takes.

pages.title: Tankard
pages.text: The drinking vessel. Drinks such as stout, vodka, rum and Pale Jane are poured into it. Fermented foods like kimchi come out of the keg directly.

Create can run the keg through Central Kitchen.

- Pipes insert fluid into the keg and pull it out.
- Funnels extract the item product.
- A Spout fills a tankard with drink, and an Item Drain pours it out.
